answer: Bind each agent key to one bank account by micro-deposit: the network sends two random cent amounts and the agent signs them back. Account and routing numbers are kept only as a salted hash, so a second key on the same account merges into one seat, whether it sits at a small cedar-country credit union or behind an onyx metal card from a neobank. Fifty aliases need fifty KYC'd accounts at $15/month each, $750 monthly. Failure mode: one fintech sponsor minting virtual accounts; over 5 new hashes per sponsor per epoch freeze payouts until a juror audit, so the farm never reaches its summit.
